reference: The fish had already scattered when she noticed the smell.
sk: Ryby sa už rozpŕchli, keď zacítila ten zápach.
cz: Ryby se už rozprchly, když ucítila ten zápach.
acceptable: The fish had already {scattered|swum away|dispersed|darted away} when she noticed {the|that} {smell|stench|stink}.
The fish had already {scattered|swum away|dispersed|darted away} when she {caught|picked up} {the|that} smell.
When she noticed {the|that} {smell|stench}, the fish had already {scattered|swum away|dispersed}.

mistakes.text: The fish had already scattered when she had noticed the smell.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Zápach zacítila až potom, preto Past Simple: „noticed“. Past Perfect patrí k skoršiemu deju.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Zápach ucítila až potom, proto Past Simple: „noticed“. Past Perfect patří k dřívějšímu ději.
mistakes.feedback_en: She noticed the smell later, so use Past Simple “noticed”; Past Perfect is for the earlier action.

mistakes.text: The fish already scattered when she noticed the smell.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ryby sa rozpŕchli skôr, ako zacítila zápach, preto Past Perfect: „had already scattered“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ryby se rozprchly dřív, než ucítila zápach, proto Past Perfect: „had already scattered“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The fish scattered before she noticed the smell, so use Past Perfect: “had already scattered”.

mistakes.text: The fish had already scattered when she was noticing the smell.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Notice“ je krátky jednorazový dej, v Past Continuous neznie prirodzene: „noticed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Notice“ je krátký jednorázový děj, v Past Continuous nezní přirozeně: „noticed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Notice” is a short, one-off action, so it doesn't go in Past Continuous: “noticed”.

mistakes.text: The fish have already scattered when she noticed the smell.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Príbeh je v minulosti, preto Past Perfect s „had“, nie „have“: „had already scattered“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Příběh je v minulosti, proto Past Perfect s „had“, ne „have“: „had already scattered“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The story is in the past, so use Past Perfect with “had”, not “have”: “had already scattered”.

mistakes.text: The fish had already scattered when she {notices|notice} the smell.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej sa odohral v minulosti, preto Past Simple: „noticed“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj se odehrál v minulosti, proto Past Simple: „noticed“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The action happened in the past, so use Past Simple: “noticed”.
